text: Concrete metadata issue: installed drizzle-kit sorts meta filenames lexicographically (bin.cjs8136) and generates from the last snapshot (19867), ignoring prevId for selection. Appending reserved0126 after applied0128 with0126_snapshot.prevId=0128 is runtime-safe but future db:generate still reads old0128, producing duplicate expiry DDL. We have not rebased/pushed or edited0128. User limited us to reserved0126/0127 and says ask if more numbers needed. Please coordinate a supported snapshot chronology or owner-side reservation resolution; no guard/tool changes or arbitrary snapshot naming from us.
